source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

observations.result: 14 focused tests pass with 53 expectations, covering Markdown embed parsing, Markdown-only note resolution, relative and ambiguous targets, external targets, heading/block slicing, fenced-code exclusion, cycle/depth guards and bounded source reads.
197 tests pass with 1,106 expectations across 60 files.
No changed-code Fallow issues; two pre-existing renderer complexity findings remain excluded by the audit gate.
Strict TypeScript checking passes for the source-aware transclusion resolver and renderer hydration path.
Routine state, contract, plugin-matrix, accessibility, layout, typecheck, 197-test, Knip and changed-file Fallow gates pass.
Main, preload, renderer and popout bundles compile successfully.
237 included paths; source tree digest is 60c7c450e1c508ba3b629f1b4ed815cee36386cd913f966b1982634020ec5214.

implemented: Added a bounded source-aware note transclusion resolver that filters to Markdown notes, preserves relative path rules, validates headings and block IDs against source bytes, excludes fenced-code identities and reports unresolved, ambiguous and external targets without guessing.
Added fence-aware heading/block source slicing, a three-level recursion bound, cycle protection and a 512 KiB base64 source cap before renderer decoding.

Extended the renderer to read only resolved Markdown notes through the existing mediated readFile IPC, render transcluded content through the safe Markdown parser, preserve stale-generation checks, keep nested task controls read-only and leave unsupported or unsafe targets as accessible inert placeholders.
Added focused resolver and source-slice tests without changing authoritative vault bytes.
limitations: PDF, SVG, unknown-binary and external-open behavior remain inert; no OS-level external opener was added.

This evidence is local implementation evidence only; visible Electron transclusion rendering, reference Obsidian parity, human accessibility review, cross-platform interaction and release signing remain pending.
Filesystem rename execution, full link dialect parity and reference reopen/save comparison remain outside this slice.
No provider, account, credential, personal vault or external reference runtime was accessed or modified.
